basics.name: Taufik Muhamad Yusup
basics.label: MSc Engineering & Policy Analysis @ TU Delft | Cloud & AI Specialist Intern @ Microsoft | van Effen Excellence Scholar
basics.summary: MSc student in Engineering and Policy Analysis at TU Delft with a background in Computer Science and Business & Technology Management from KAIST. Interested in applying technology, especially AI, for social good, with a focus on computational sustainability, technology policy, and systems thinking.

education.institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
education.area: Computer Science (Double Major in Business & Technology Management, Minor in Science & Technology Policy)

work.name: Microsoft
highlights: Drove enterprise AI agent adoption across Microsoft Netherlands under a Customer Zero initiative, co-creating a gamified weekly campaign that lifted weekly usage from ~40% to ~60% and earned recognition at the NL Together all-hands.
Automated partner-attach and CAF opportunity tracking across 13 sales territories using Microsoft Power Platform, replacing a manual weekly report with automated notifications.
Partnered with the executive office to debug and restore a production AI agent (NOVA) to a functional, deployment-ready state.
Researched how sovereign cloud and governance mindsets shape enterprise AI and cloud adoption, turning findings into strategic go-to-market insights.

work.name: LTS, Inc.
highlights: Redesigned gas adjustment workflows, reducing manual effort and enabling smoother operations for junior staff.
Built a React-based prototype that improved efficiency and helped streamline client operations through data-driven insights.
Conducted process mapping and analysis, identifying key inefficiencies and recommending strategic improvements.

work.name: MetaEarth Lab, KAIST
highlights: Explored deep learning models to reconstruct paleo-precipitation data using the 20th Century Reanalysis dataset and proxy records from the ISO2K database.
Improved reconstruction accuracy, increasing Pearson correlation from 0.183 to 0.356 and R-squared from 0.023 to 0.267.

work.name: Center for Anthropocene Studies, KAIST
highlights: Developed the research project 'Posh Protesters: Cultural Capital and Pro-environmental Political Action Participation'.
Cleaned and analyzed large survey datasets across multiple variables for accuracy and reliability.
Performed regression analysis to assess the influence of socio-economic status on environmental activism.

work.name: Daewoong Pharmaceutical
highlights: Executed competitive benchmarking to provide data-backed UX/UI recommendations for a telemedicine app.
Assisted in market entry strategy development for Indonesia, aligning business objectives with local consumer behavior.
Translated 8,000+ rows of app content from Korean to English, boosting the Wellcheck App's global usability and accessibility.

work.name: Schoters
highlights: Mentored 30+ students in university admissions and scholarships, with several securing spots at top institutions in Canada, China, Japan, Korea, and Australia.
Optimized application strategies, refining essays and interview preparation to strengthen students' admissions prospects.
